findings.issue: The `maxIterations` resolution row states the expansive derived budget only as `min(24, max(10, 2·c·(S + maxDepth − 1)))`. `expansiveBudget` returns the loop default before that formula whenever no depth-1 node was seeded: frontier-admit.cjs:273 `if (seededCount === 0) return floor;` (floor = the run's default budget, 10 for research), and the nodes term is only computed from line 274 on. So the documented formula overstates the budget as soon as `maxDepth` is configured above 3 and the seed admits nothing or every seed is pruned (S = 0, maxDepth 8: code gives 10, formula gives 14). The sibling review setup table states the zero-seed case ("and kept at `7` when S is 0") and the workflow text already says it (deep-research.yaml:783 "With no seeded node, every seed pruned, the budget stays at the loop default"), so only this row is stale.

fix.old: with S the depth-1 nodes the seed admitted and c 1; any other source is kept as given
fix.new: with S the depth-1 nodes the seed admitted, c 1, and the budget kept at `10` when S is 0; any other source is kept as given

findings.issue: The fan-out seed step tells the operator that "frontier-admit.cjs is the only writer of the node store and the frontier inbox rows", in the very step whose next act is `fanout-run.cjs` splitting the seeded nodes. fanout-run.cjs does not go through frontier-admit for that: `writeLineageFrontierStore` writes `{lineageDir}/frontier-nodes.jsonl` itself (line 371-372) and appends `{lineageDir}/inbox.jsonl` (line 377) for every expansive fan-out lineage before it spawns, and it is called at fanout-run.cjs:3960 with `{ inbox: loopType !== 'review' }`. The claim only holds for the root/single-executor store, so a reader tracing who writes a lineage's store is pointed at the wrong script.
